question.text: A Cat III AIF 'LMN Growth Fund I' has tenure of 5 years, with First Close on November 15, 2023. Ignoring extensions, on what date does its tenure end?

explanation.text: The Logic: Tenure of a close-ended Cat III AIF starts from date of First Close. 5 years from Nov 15, 2023 = tenure ends Nov 14, 2028. The Trap: Nov 15, 2028 would be Day 1 of Year 6. June/Sept are when the PPM was filed/approved — unrelated to tenure start. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with the tenure-from-First-Close rule in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Note: pre-Nov 17, 2022 First Closes continued from Final Close — verify the cut-off date when assessing legacy funds.
